Hotend thermistor replacement reference display

Existing block, heater, nozzle and thermistor geometry: the community hotend model by Julian0815, Open Community License v1.
https://www.printables.com/model/1533491-prusa-core-one-full-cad-with-nextruder-hotend
Full terms: ../../licenses/OCL-1.0.txt

One retained T6-screw illustration is independently authored procedural reference geometry by CORE One Community Guide contributors. The official thermistor guide specifies one screw that is loosened but left in the block. Its displayed M3-class envelope and 4 mm length are estimates fitted to the reference model's 2.55 mm minor-diameter bore; they are not an official replacement-screw specification. The helix, recess, travel and finish illustrate the action and are not manufacturing dimensions, a turn-count instruction or a torque specification. No supplier screw surfaces or mesh payloads are copied.

Screw geometry: CC BY-SA 4.0.
Full terms: ../../licenses/CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt
Preferred editable source: ../../thermistor-service-geometry.js and the referenced procedural screw builder in ../../heater-service-geometry.js.
Procedure source and generator: ../../../source/thermistor-replacement/

New procedural code and adapters (thermistor-service-geometry.js, thermistor-service-model.js and the procedure generator): MIT License.
